name: Chataquila to the Maragua crater
why: Down an Inca stone path from the Chataquila chapel to the Jalq'a weaving villages and the red and purple folded rock of the Maragua crater.
book: Community fees; a guide from Sucre is advised (paths are not marked). Night in a community lodge at Maragua.
water: Carry 2 litres; shops only in the villages.
dangers: Unmarked paths: easy to get lost.

points.name: Chataquila
points.note: A white chapel on a rock pass above the valley.

points.name: Chaunaca
points.note: A village by the river where the Inca road ends.

points.name: Maragua
points.note: A village inside a wide bowl of folded red rock.
